title: Annabi Koɗorɗe Carfaaɓe
intro: E nder jeereendeeji ɓuuɓɗi e nder leydi Aarabeeɓe ɓooyndi, limre feeñii e nder yimɓe anndaaɓe e karallaagal mum en keeringal. Galleeji maɓɓe ina ummii e kaaƴe tiiɗɗe, kono ɓerɗe maɓɓe ina tiiɗi no feewi e koɗli ɗi ɓe njuɓɓini ɗii. Nelaaɗo Alla ari e maande wootere, kaawis — kono mawnikinaare e ƴattoore addani ɗum batte jaawɗe e kulɓiniiɗe. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude maccuɗo tedduɗo mo leñol mum suɓii halkaare e ardaade?
clues: Mi neldaama jeertinoowo leñol am, nodduɗo ɗum e dewal Alla gooto.
Leñol am ina wuuri hakkunde kaaƴe dime, ina njuppa hoɗorɗe mawɗe e nder koye.
Gelooɗi debbo kaawis yalti e haayre tiiɗnde e duwaawu am, maande laaɓnde ummoraade e Joom baawɗe.
Mi wi’i yim6e am yo ndenndu ndiyam e oo geloocfo debbo, woto bonnu cfum.
Yimɓe am mbaɗi feere ngam haɓde e gelooɗi ɗii, ɓe mberli ɗum, ɓe ndartini halkaare maɓɓe.
Yerɓo leydi kulɓiniingo yani e leñol am, ɓe keddii ina njillondiri e hoɗorde maɓɓe.

arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ
verse: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets], (22:42)
